text:
Maria Chen: Thanks everyone for joining the security segment in today's all-hands. A few follow-ups from leadership and Ops that came up live — collecting questions here so we can triage and assign.
Alex Rivera: Quick first Q: SOC2 evidence asks — what’s the expected delivery cadence for the artifact bundles (e.g., policy docs, control evidence) for customers requesting evidence? who owns the package?
Sanjay Patel: @Alex good one. Current plan: monthly rolling bundles + ad-hoc exports for audits. Security will own the bundle creation, EngOps will help with automated exports. Need to confirm SLAs for ad-hoc exports.
Jess Liu: Who is the contact for ISO readiness? We heard ISO was targeted next quarter — any specific scope differences vs SOC2? :thinking_face:
Maria Chen: ISO scope will largely mirror SOC2 controls but with extra emphasis on supply chain and third-party vendor assessments. @Sanjay will coordinate, but Product Security will run the readiness checklist.
Tyler Nguyen: KMS/BYOK timeline — leadership asked if customers can bring keys to Private deployments by EOY. What's achievable without breaking key split trust model?
Sanjay Patel: BYOK for Private VPC is feasible earlier than hosted BYOK. Proposal: 1) Private deployments (VPC/on-prem) support BYOK with KMS integration in Q3; 2) Hosted BYOK (customer-managed keys in our hosted control plane) requires HSM changes, targeted Q4 and gated by SOC2 re-eval.
Cory Brooks: Audit log retention question from compliance team — what retention options will we offer? default and max retention for enterprise customers?
Alex Rivera: Proposed tiers: default 90 days, enterprise adjustable up to 7 years with export hooks to S3/GCS. Need to validate storage cost model and per-GB export SLA.
Jess Liu: For key rotation, do we have a forced-rotation policy and a mechanism to rotate without downtime for cached KV in inference nodes?
Sanjay Patel: Key rotation plan: automated rotation in KMS + rewrap mechanism. Runtime will support rewrap of KV cache at lease boundaries; nodes will request new wrapped keys on rotation windows. No planned downtime but we need a few integration tests.
Maria Chen: Leadership also asked for concrete SLA/KPI asks to communicate externally. Suggestions: p99 latency target, error budget %, and audit-export SLA. Any concrete numbers to propose?
Tyler Nguyen: Suggest p99 <= 350ms for hosted small models, error budget 0.1% per month, audit-export within 24 hours for standard, 4 hours for enterprise urgent exports.
Cory Brooks: +1 on export SLAs, but put a caveat: exports require access checks and may include redaction steps — 4 hours only for pre-approved enterprise audits.
Jess Liu: Can we get a short example of the audit export format so customers know what to expect? JSON lines with event_type, user, ts, request_id? :point_up:
Alex Rivera: Draft export schema (example):
```
{
  "ts": "2026-03-23T16:22:10Z",
  "request_id": "req_abc123",
  "user": "svc-account:acme",
  "route": "/v1/generate",
  "model": "redwood/gpt-13b",
  "tokens_in": 42,
  "tokens_out": 210,
  "outcome": "success",
  "ip": "10.2.3.4",
  "kms_key_id": "projects/foo/locations/global/keyRings/r1/cryptoKeys/k1"
}
```
Sanjay Patel: Also adding proof-of-rotation events to the schema for compliance.
engops-bot: Deployment log: private-kms-integration branch merged to staging at 2367890180 — smoke tests passing :white_check_mark:
Maria Chen: Action items from this thread: 1) @Sanjay to publish BYOK timeline and gating checklist (target EOD next Tue). 2) @Alex to draft audit-export schema and retention tier pricing. 3) @Jess to own ISO readiness checklist and vendor assessment plan. 4) @Tyler to propose SLA/KPI doc for public website.
Alex Rivera: I'll push a first draft of the export schema to docs repo and ping security for feedback.
Sanjay Patel: I'll schedule an ops sync for BYOK gating items and include runtime test owners.
Jess Liu: I'll collate ISO controls vs SOC2 differences and share a gap matrix by Friday.
Tyler Nguyen: Will compile the SLA/KPI page and propose marketing-friendly copy.
Cory Brooks: Any legal sign-off steps we should preempt? export of PII for EU customers needs DP eval.
Maria Chen: Good flag — @legal and @privacy-team will be pulled in once draft artifacts are ready. Note: no customer-facing promises until legal signs off.
Alex Rivera: One more ask from leadership — can we surface a short one-pager for sales: "what to tell customers now" (BYOK availability by deployment type, audit export tiers, ISO/SOC2 timelines). I'll start a template.
Maria Chen: Thanks all. If any urgent escalations come up, drop them here and we'll triage. :thumbsup:
